cohort: 386 women with a triplet pregnancy who delivered between 26 + 0 and 40 + 0 weeks of gestation in the years 1999-2008
finding: In women with triplet pregnancies, caesarean delivery was not associated with reduced perinatal mortality and morbidity compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was not associated with reduced perinatal mortality and morbidity compared to vaginal delivery in women with triplet pregnancies.
